candidate.title: Updating a group without `visible` param unintentionally flips visibility to false
reports: public group members page fetches only 50 users and has no pagination controls, making later members inaccessible
public group members page makes only one request and has no pagination, silently truncating groups with more than 50 members
/groups/:groupid/members.json changes its response from a serialized array to an object, breaking api clients that expect the existing array response.
members endpoint changes its response from a top-level array to {members, meta}, breaking existing api clients and plugins without compatibility support
